Parking the roadmap: 1 of 2 stages is complete, and Stage 2 (Closure notices) goes to the deferred backlog. Since no tools run in this turn, here are the steps I'll take.

**1. Read the deferred-item schema and the current backlog.**
```
Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md   # exact location to confirm
Read specs/deferred_items.md   # may not exist yet
```

**2. Add Stage 2 to `specs/deferred_items.md`** under a new section, filled in to match that schema:
```markdown
## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06

- [ ] Closure notices: email boat operators within an hour of a lock closing
      Context: Track B of specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md (Stage 2, outcome O5).
        Parked when the canal study's funding ended. Planned to run without a stage
        spec (ROUTING: writing-plans). It relies on the closure log's live feed and
        does not depend on Stage 1's river-level findings.
      Size: small (one closure-log check every 10 minutes)
      Done when: a notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and a test shows an
        email reaching every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry.
```

**3. Move the roadmap and mark it parked.**
```
git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
```
At the top of the moved file, below the existing header, I'll add one line:
> PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete

No methodology or critique files retire with it. The roadmap came from your own description on 2026-10-14, not from a written spec, so it has no input files.

**4. Commit on `main`.**
```
git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap (1 of 2 stages complete): funding ended"
```

One thing to know: only Stage 2 becomes a backlog item, because the backlog holds stages. The three unstaged research ideas (O2 the 7-day outlook, O3 the per-lock curves, O4 the map) stay in the parked roadmap's ranked list. They won't show up in the backlog or age there. Stage 1's findings file and their measured costs stay in `specs/` for anyone who picks this up later.
